objective: In the registered Field Ops Demo app, add a fixed Service Visit on_update hook that reads the permitted Customer through Frappe ORM, idempotently writes a disposable customer snapshot marker through frappe.db.set_value, and installs a translated and escaped Jinja Print Format fixture. Include focused Document API, idempotency, escaping, reread and rollback tests.

orm_contract.read: frappe.get_list with permission filtering, bound filters and a one-row limit
orm_contract.write: frappe.db.set_value on the current Service Visit name with update_modified disabled
orm_contract.idempotency: replace the single fixed marker line; never append a duplicate

evidence: registered source revision and status hash
Document API reread after hook write
exact reverse patch restores the registered revision
negative_probes: a second on_update does not duplicate the marker
an unavailable Customer produces no cross-record lookup result
HTML in notes is escaped by the rendered template
migrate, build and restart remain outside this proposal

rollback.guard: registered revision plus exact applied patch hash
rollback.expected_result: all five reviewed paths return to the pre-apply Git state
